title: The front reviews code itself instead of starting a critic
what: Asked for a review, the front starts a critic every time (the delegate skill's rule), and the bench scenario review-offbyone shows it in at least 9 of 10 runs.
why: 30 Oct, bench review-offbyone (reports ~/.relay/bench/2026-10-29T23-05-04Z and 2026-10-29T23-11-39Z, 6 runs per profile): the Opus front started no critic in 5 of 12 runs (4 of 6 with the active profile, 1 of 6 with the Fable-judge profile) and reviewed the code itself; the grader delegated-to-a-critic failed. This also spoils any comparison of judge models: only 2 of 6 active runs reached an Opus critic. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: relay bench active --scenario review-offbyone --runs 4 (30 Oct): delegated-to-a-critic failed in runs 0 and 1 of the active profile.
pass_cases: 10 runs of review-offbyone with the active profile: delegated-to-a-critic passes in at least 9

fact: Front decision (owner can reverse; measure before recommending): the change's one open finding (Gap: the rate at which the front starts a critic is not measured) is settled by a 10-run bench of scenario review-offbyone on the branch's rules, about $3-8, before any landing. Baseline on master rules: no critic in 5 of 12 runs (29-30 Oct).

Bench 2026-10-30T02-11-19Z (scenario review-offbyone, 5 runs on the branch's rules, $0.71 a run): the front started a critic in 5 of 5 runs (grader delegated-to-a-critic passed every run), against 7 of 12 on master rules (29-30 Oct). The off-by-one bug was found in 1 of 5 runs with the Opus critic; earlier benches: Opus critic 1 of 2, Fable critic 5 of 5.

question: Does the bench (the front started a critic in 5 of 5 runs with the new rule, 7 of 12 without) settle the change's open Gap, so the change lands?
options: b. Run 10 more runs first (about $7, 20 min).
answer: - a. Да, отправить (рекомендую): 5 из 5 против 7 из 12 — явная разница.
reading: Option a: the bench settles the Gap; the change lands.

question: Switch the reviewer (critic) from Opus to Fable? Bench on the off-by-one scenario: Fable found the bug in 5 of 5 runs, Opus in 2 of 7; review is $86.63 of $356.51 agent cost this week (24%), and Fable costs about twice Opus per token.
options: a. Switch the critic to Fable after 10 runs on the cheap set confirm no other job gets worse (about $10).
